extDescription.message: Right-click images or select screenshots to reverse-engineer image generation prompts with AI

commandCaptureSelectionDescription.message: Select a screenshot region and analyze it

languageSettingsDescription.message: Set the language used by extension pages, context menus, and selection hints. Changes apply immediately.

optionsSubtitle.message: Turn images into reusable prompt cards.

firstSuccessDescription.message: Configure your Vision API, then analyze an image by right-clicking it or selecting a screenshot region.

firstSuccessPromise.message: Choose API analysis or ChatGPT Plus Assist, then analyze your first image and take the result with you.

firstSuccessChooseModeDescription.message: Use automatic API analysis, or choose ChatGPT Plus Assist to prepare an image and instructions.

firstSuccessAnalyzeImageDescription.message: Right-clicking a web image is fastest. Use screenshot selection when an image is restricted, cannot be right-clicked, or you prefer not to grant site access.

firstSuccessTakeResultDescription.message: API mode provides structured results. In Assist mode, download the image, copy the instructions, and finish in ChatGPT.

analysisModeDescription.message: Choose automatic API analysis or finish manually in the ChatGPT Plus web app.

analysisModeApiDescription.message: PromptLens calls your configured OpenAI-compatible Vision API and displays structured results.

analysisModeChatgptDescription.message: No API Key required. PromptLens prepares the image and instructions for you to upload and paste in ChatGPT.

analysisModeChatgptNote.message: ChatGPT Plus Assist does not call an API or automatically upload, send, or read ChatGPT responses.

apiConfigModeHintApi.message: PromptLens uses these API fields to call your configured model service automatically.

apiConfigModeHintChatgpt.message: ChatGPT Plus Assist is active, so the API fields are optional. Fill them in when you switch back to automatic API analysis.

imagePermissionDescription.message: Right-click analysis of remote images needs one-time permission. Screenshot selection works without that permission.

imagePermissionGrantedDescription.message: Granted. You can right-click images on any website for analysis.

imagePermissionMissingDescription.message: Not granted. Remote image analysis may report insufficient permission; you can use screenshot selection instead.

imagePermissionGrantedMessage.message: Image access permission granted. You can now right-click images on any website for analysis.

imagePermissionDeniedMessage.message: Permission was denied. Grant it again when needed, or use “Select screenshot region and analyze”.

apiConfigDescription.message: PromptLens does not include a model service. Enter your own Vision API and select its OpenAI-compatible or Anthropic protocol. The API Key stays in your local browser, and images are sent only to your configured Base URL.

modelAdapterHint.message: Choose the request protocol used by the provider. Anthropic uses the Messages API and tool_use structured output.

providerPresetHint.message: Presets fill the API protocol and Base URL, not the API Key or Model. Actual availability depends on your analysis result and provider documentation.

apiBaseUrlHint.message: HTTPS is required. Local model services may use http://localhost or http://127.0.0.1. You may enter the matching endpoint or just /v1.

apiKeyHint.message: The key is stored in local chrome.storage.local. Analysis requests go to your configured Base URL, so use only trusted services.

apiModelHint.message: Enter a model that supports image analysis. If right-click analysis returns a result, the configuration works.

structuredOutputModeHint.message: Prompt-constrained JSON is the default. Select JSON Object or Native JSON Schema only when the provider supports response_format.

structuredOutputAnthropicHint.message: The Anthropic protocol always uses tool_use with input_schema, so this option does not apply.

apiPrivacyBoundary.message: PromptLens has no backend of its own. During analysis, your configured Base URL may receive the API Key, image URL or screenshot data, template prompt, model name, and business context.

rightClickVsSelectionDescription.message: Right-clicking web images is fastest, but some remote images require optional site access. Screenshot selection is more flexible for hotlink protection, canvas, blob, login pages, and content without a context menu.

defaultTemplateHint.message: Built-in templates are organized by output format. Use custom templates for platform-specific differences.

targetPlatformHint.message: This only affects tag and weighting rules. It does not add version, Seed, LoRA, or workflow-node parameters.

customTemplatesDescription.message: Built-in templates are read-only. Copy one to create a custom template for platform-specific differences.

customTemplateDescriptionPlaceholder.message: Explain the output format or platform-specific behavior

customTemplateInstructionPlaceholder.message: Describe only template-specific differences. The fixed JSON output requirements are appended automatically.

customTemplateInstructionHint.message: Custom Instructions are limited to 4,000 characters and cannot change the final JSON Schema.

customTemplateInstructionLimit.message: Custom Instructions are limited to {{LIMIT}} characters. The fixed JSON output requirements are appended automatically.

customTemplateBuiltInReadonly.message: Built-in templates are read-only. Click “Copy current template” to maintain platform-specific differences.

providerExamplesHint.message: These examples help with configuration and do not mean every model supports images.

providerRecipeCustomCheck.message: Confirm that the service supports /chat/completions and image_url input.

providerRecipeCustomCaution.message: Do not use an unfamiliar or untrusted address as the Base URL.

providerRecipeOpenaiModel.message: Choose a model that supports image input

providerRecipeOpenaiCheck.message: After saving, verify it with right-click analysis or screenshot selection.

providerRecipeOpenaiCaution.message: Model capabilities and pricing vary. Check your provider console.

providerRecipeAnthropicModel.message: Choose a Claude model that supports image input

providerRecipeAnthropicCheck.message: Select the Anthropic Messages API protocol; PromptLens uses tool_use for the structured result.

providerRecipeAnthropicCaution.message: Check Anthropic documentation for model names, image support, pricing, and data policies.

providerRecipeOllamaModel.message: A locally installed model that supports image input

providerRecipeOllamaCheck.message: Confirm that Ollama is running and the model supports image input.

providerRecipeOllamaCaution.message: Local HTTP is allowed only for localhost or 127.0.0.1.

providerRecipeRouterModel.message: Choose a model explicitly documented for Vision

providerRecipeRouterCheck.message: If analysis fails, first check the model name, routing, and provider error logs.

providerRecipeRouterCaution.message: A Provider preset does not mean every model supports images.

providerRecipeDeepseekModel.message: Follow official documentation and actual analysis results

providerRecipeDeepseekCheck.message: A reachable DeepSeek text endpoint does not mean every model can analyze images.

providerRecipeDeepseekCaution.message: Do not interpret the DeepSeek preset as image support for every DeepSeek model.

historySettingsDescription.message: Off by default. When enabled, PromptLens stores result text, source domain, original image URL, and page URL, but no image thumbnail.

imagePreprocessingDescription.message: Adjust only when images are too large or output quality is unstable.

templateDetailedDescription.message: Complete structured output for general analysis and further editing.

templateNaturalDescription.message: A fluent English prompt for natural-language prompt platforms.

templateTagsDescription.message: Weighted positive and negative tags for tag-driven workflows.

templateConciseDescription.message: A one-sentence summary for quick testing.

templateMarketingDescription.message: Turn a commercial visual into a diagnosis that owners can evaluate, teams can execute, and AI can adapt at low cost.

resultStatusOptionalBusiness.message: You may add optional business context.

resultStatusPartial.message: Analysis complete, but {{COUNT}} result items are incomplete.

resultPartialDescription.message: The model returned the main result, but {{COUNT}} items did not satisfy the output contract. Existing content remains usable; retry before exporting a final result.

resultLoadingPrepareChatgpt.message: Preparing the image and ChatGPT instructions...

resultLoadingCallModel.message: Calling the AI model to analyze the image...

resultNextStepPromptTitle.message: Copy a prompt or export the result

resultNextStepPromptDescription.message: Copy this result into Midjourney, Jimeng, Kling, Stable Diffusion, Flux, or another image-generation tool for further testing.

resultNextStepPrompt2.message: Copy the Tags as style references.

resultNextStepPrompt3.message: Use the Recreate or Creative Extension variant for recreation and expansion.

resultNextStepMarketingTitle.message: Turn the diagnosis into a team brief

resultNextStepMarketingDescription.message: Share this result with an owner, designer, media buyer, or client to decide the next low-cost visual revision.

resultNextStepMarketing1.message: Download the Markdown brief as a discussion document.

resultNextStepMarketing2.message: Copy the low-cost revision suggestions into the next creative iteration.

resultNextStepMarketing3.message: If the business context is incomplete, analyze again with more context.

resultMarketingHint.message: A commercial visual breakdown for small-business owners and business teams.

businessContextDescription.message: Add an industry, product, channel, or audience to make the visual marketing diagnosis more relevant. You can also continue without it.

businessContextPlaceholder.message: Example: This is a product hero image for an independent store. The goal is to improve first-screen clicks and add-to-cart intent with a limited budget, so prioritize low-cost visual revisions.

businessContextExample.message: This is a product hero image for an independent store. The goal is to improve first-screen clicks and add-to-cart intent with a limited budget, so prioritize low-cost visual revisions.

businessContextPrivacy.message: Used only for this request and sent to your configured AI provider. PromptLens has no backend and does not upload it elsewhere by default.

chatgptAssistTitle.message: Analyze this image with ChatGPT Plus

chatgptAssistDescription.message: PromptLens prepared the image and analysis instructions locally. Upload them manually, or grant access so PromptLens can try to fill the ChatGPT page.

chatgptAssistStepOpen.message: Open ChatGPT, upload the image, and paste the instructions.

chatgptAssistStepSend.message: Send in ChatGPT and keep the result there.

chatgptAssistExperimentalDescription.message: “Try sending to ChatGPT” requests access to chatgpt.com and attempts to fill the image and instructions into ChatGPT. It does not read or save ChatGPT responses, and it never sends automatically. ChatGPT page changes may cause failure; manual download and copy remain available.

chatgptAssistInstructionHint.message: Assist mode does not read or save ChatGPT responses. Copy or export the result in ChatGPT if you want to keep it.

chatgptAssistPrivacyBoundary.message: PromptLens does not send Assist-mode images to an API or its own backend. After you upload to ChatGPT, OpenAI's privacy policy, account settings, and usage limits apply.

chatgptAssistReady.message: The image and instructions are ready. Download the image, copy the instructions, and finish in ChatGPT.

chatgptAssistPermissionNeeded.message: Access to chatgpt.com is required to try filling the image and instructions. PromptLens does not read responses or send automatically.

chatgptAssistPermissionDenied.message: Access to chatgpt.com was not granted. Download the image and copy the instructions manually.

chatgptAssistPayloadExpired.message: The automatic transfer data expired. The image and instructions are still available on this page for manual upload.

chatgptAssistTabOpenFailed.message: Unable to open ChatGPT. Visit https://chatgpt.com/ manually.

chatgptAssistConnectFailed.message: Unable to connect to the ChatGPT page. Download the image and copy the instructions for manual upload.

chatgptAssistInputNotFound.message: ChatGPT opened, but no input box was found. Copy the instructions manually.

chatgptAssistInstructionFailed.message: ChatGPT opened, but the instructions could not be filled. Copy them manually.

chatgptAssistImageInputNotFound.message: The instructions were filled, but no image upload input was found. Download and upload the image manually.

chatgptAssistImageAttachFailed.message: The instructions were filled, but automatic image attachment failed. Download and upload the image manually.

chatgptAssistInstructionOnly.message: ChatGPT opened and the instructions were filled. Confirm whether the image is attached, then send manually.

chatgptAssistSuccess.message: PromptLens attempted to attach the image and fill the instructions. Confirm them in ChatGPT, then send manually.

chatgptAssistAutoFailed.message: Automatic transfer failed. Download the image and copy the instructions for manual upload.

chatgptAssistOpenedWaiting.message: ChatGPT opened. PromptLens will wait for the page to settle before filling the image and instructions. Confirm them in ChatGPT and send manually. If no image appears, return here and download it.

chatgptAssistImageNotReady.message: The image is not ready. Run the analysis again.

chatgptAssistImageDownloadFailed.message: Image download failed. Reopen the result page or use screenshot selection.

chatgptAssistCopyBlocked.message: The browser blocked automatic copying. Select and copy the instructions below manually.

chatgptAssistOpenedManual.message: ChatGPT opened. Upload the downloaded image and paste the instructions.

chatgptAssistCopiedAndOpened.message: Instructions copied and ChatGPT opened. Upload the downloaded image.

chatgptAssistOpenedCopyBlocked.message: ChatGPT opened, but the browser blocked automatic copying. Copy the instructions below manually.

chatgptAssistCopiedOpenFailed.message: The instructions were copied, but ChatGPT could not be opened automatically. Visit https://chatgpt.com/ manually.

chatgptAssistCopyAndOpenFailed.message: The browser blocked copying and ChatGPT could not be opened automatically. Copy the instructions and visit https://chatgpt.com/ manually.

variantsHint.message: Three read-only directions that you can copy directly into image-generation tools for testing.

variantRecreateIntent.message: Reproduce the reference subject, composition, style, lighting, and materials as closely as possible

variantCreativeIntent.message: Keep the core visual language while exploring a new direction

variantCommercialIntent.message: Adapt the prompt for advertising, product, poster, and brand-visual use

marketingDisclaimer.message: This diagnosis is generated from the image and user-provided business context. It is for marketing creative and visual-expression reference only and does not predict advertising performance, business results, or provide professional media-buying advice.

marketingExportTitle.message: I used AI to break down a commercial visual

marketingNoBusinessContext.message: No business context was provided. The following diagnosis is based only on visible image evidence.

marketingExportSection1.message: Owner summary: what is this image selling?

marketingExportSection2.message: Who does it reach: target customer and use context

marketingExportSection3.message: Why it stops attention: visual strategy and emotional hook

marketingExportSection4.message: What may reduce conversion: friction points

marketingExportSection5.message: How a small business can adapt it at low cost

marketingExportSection6.message: Execution brief for AI, design, and operations

marketingExportSection8.message: What to test in the next visual
